# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/jobs

Lists all jobs for a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-277`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| status | query | string | False |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

## Response
